shortDescription: Source-backed Caribbean intelligence, opportunities and FTN workflows with clear provenance and permission boundaries.
longDescription: FTN ibis helps people discover Caribbean opportunities, source-backed regional intelligence and relevant FTN capabilities. It returns founder-reviewed records, original source links and explicit uncertainty notices. The initial app is read-only and does not submit applications, send messages or access private conversations.
dataAccess: Public FTN-indexed records only in the initial slice; no raw conversation history or private workspace access.
reviewNote: This is an FTN internal submission draft, not a claim that the endpoint is deployed or approved by OpenAI.
